title: Ozelge Question Answer Benchmark
description: Schema for storing benchmark question-answer pairs linked to ozelge documents from data/ozelge_veri.json.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this benchmark data format.

datasetName.description: Optional human-readable name for the benchmark dataset.

sourceFile.description: Optional source data file path, for example data/ozelge_veri.json.

ozelgeler.description: Ozelge documents with one or more benchmark question-answer pairs.

ozelgeId.description: Identifier of the ozelge document. Prefer evrakOid from data/ozelge_veri.json.

sayi.description: Optional sayi value from the ozelge source document.

tarih.description: Optional ozelge date from the source document, usually formatted as YYYYMMDD.

questions.description: Question-answer pairs derived from this ozelge.

questionId.description: Optional stable identifier for this question-answer pair.

questionText.description: Question text for the benchmark item.

answerText.description: Expected answer text for the benchmark item.

answerSource.description: Optional source span, quote, paragraph reference, or note explaining where the answer came from.

tags.description: Optional labels such as tax type, topic, difficulty, or retrieval category.
